ayahs.1: Ek sawaal karne wale ne is azaab ka sawaal kiya jo waazeh hone wala hai.
ayahs.2: Kaafiron par, jise koi hataane wala nahin.
ayahs.3: Is Allah ki taraf se jo seerhiyon waala hai.
ayahs.4: Jis ki taraf farishte aur rooh chadhte hain ek din mein jis ki miqdaar pachaas hazaar saal ki hai.
ayahs.5: Pas tu achhi tarah sabr kar.
ayahs.6: Beshak yeh is (azaab) ko door samajh rahe hain.
ayahs.7: Aur hum ise qareeb hi dekhte hain.
ayahs.8: Jis din aasman misl-e-talchhat ke ho jaayega.
ayahs.9: Aur pahaad misl-e-rangeen oon ke ho jaayenge.
ayahs.10: Aur koi dost kisi dost ko na poochhega.
ayahs.11: (Halaanke) ek doosre ko dikha diye jaayenge, gunaahgaar is din ke azaab ke badle fidye mein apne beton ko.
ayahs.12: Apni biwi ko aur apne bhai ko.
ayahs.13: Aur apne kunbe ko jo ise panaah deta tha.
ayahs.14: Aur roo-e-zameen ke sab logon ko dena chaahega taake yeh ise nijaat dila de.
ayahs.15: (Magar) hargiz yeh na hoga, yaqeenan woh shola wali (aag) hai.
ayahs.16: Jo munh aur sar ki khaal kheench laane wali hai.
ayahs.17: Woh har is shakhs ko pukaaregi jo peechhe hat-ta aur munh modta hai.
ayahs.18: Aur jama karke sambhaal rakhta hai.
ayahs.19: Beshak insaan bade kacche-dil wala banaaya gaya hai.
ayahs.20: Jab ise museebat pahunchti hai to hadbada uthta hai.
ayahs.21: Aur jab raahat milti hai to bukhl karne lagta hai.
ayahs.23: Jo apni namaaz par hameshgi karne wale hain.
ayahs.24: Aur jin ke maalon mein muqarrara hissa hai.
ayahs.25: Maangne walon ka bhi aur sawaal se bachne walon ka bhi.
ayahs.26: Aur jo insaaf ke din par yaqeen rakhte hain.
ayahs.27: Aur jo apne Rabb ke azaab se darte rehte hain.
ayahs.28: Beshak un ke Rabb ka azaab be-khauf hone ki cheez nahin.
ayahs.29: Aur jo log apni sharmgaahon ki (haraam se) hifaazat karte hain.
ayahs.30: Haan un ki biwiyon aur laondiyon ke baare mein jin ke woh maalik hain unhein koi malaamat nahin.
ayahs.31: Ab jo koi is ke alaawa (raah) dhoondega to aise log hadd se guzar jaane wale honge.
ayahs.32: Aur jo apni amaanaton ka aur apne qaul-o-qaraar ka paas rakhte hain.
ayahs.33: Aur jo apni gawaahiyon par seedhe aur qaayim rehte hain.
ayahs.34: Aur jo apni namaazon ki hifaazat karte hain.
ayahs.35: Yehi log jannaton mein izzat wale honge.
ayahs.36: Pas kaafiron ko kya ho gaya hai ke woh teri taraf daudte aate hain.
ayahs.38: Kya un mein se har ek ki tawaqqo yeh hai ke woh ne'maton wali jannat mein daakhil kiya jaayega?
ayahs.39: (Aisa) hargiz na hoga. Hum ne unhein is (cheez) se paida kiya hai jise woh jaante hain.
ayahs.40: Pas mujhe qasam hai mashriqon aur maghribon ke Rabb ki (ke) hum yaqeenan qaadir hain.
ayahs.41: Is par ke un ke iwaz un se achhe log le aayen aur hum aajiz nahin hain.
ayahs.42: Pas tu unhein jhagadta khelta chhod de yahan tak ke yeh apne is din se jaa milen jis ka un se waada kiya jaata hai.
ayahs.43: Jis din yeh qabron se daudte hue niklenge, goya ke woh kisi jagah ki taraf tez tez ja rahe hain.
ayahs.44: Un ki aankhen jhuki hui hongi, un par zillat chha rahi hogi, yeh hai woh din jis ka un se waada kiya jaata tha.
